title: Clock in / out
disabled: Clocking is disabled by the current policy. Contact your administrator.
chooseSite: Choose the site for this punch
siteLimits: Within {radius} m; location accuracy must be {accuracy} m or better.
locationPurpose: Tapping a punch requests one foreground location to validate your chosen site and accuracy. No background tracking, device storage of coordinates, or offline uploads.
h5Location: Browser location requires a secure connection and permission. Availability and accuracy vary; use a configured App or mini program if unavailable.
mpLocation: The mini program needs platform location access, a privacy declaration and your permission. A successful build does not confirm platform approval.
appLocation: The App needs foreground location permission and system location services. Location is requested only for this punch; no background permission is used.
locationUnavailable: Location is unavailable. Check location services and foreground permission. The punch will not bypass location checks.
locationDenied: Location permission was denied. Allow foreground location in your system or app settings before retrying.
locationInvalid: Valid coordinates or accuracy were not provided. Obtain a new location.
locationAccuracy: Location accuracy must be {max} m or better. Try again where the signal is stronger.
locationOutside: You are outside the selected office site. No punch was submitted.
unavailable: Clock information is unavailable or this tenant does not include attendance.
uncertain: The punch result is unconfirmed. Query it first; only retry the original request after it is confirmed absent. Do not create another punch.
dayChanged: The server work date changed. An unresolved old-day request will not be rewritten as a new-day punch. Check your records before confirming a new action.
recordHint: Only your own records. No record does not imply absence or lateness. Day shifts only; no offline uploads.
invalidMonth: Enter a valid month or a date within that month.
